name: Campinas

queries.query: Campinas SIG municipal camada Lotes DIDC metadados geoespaciais shapefile cadastro territorial
queries.scope: Find first-party Campinas cadastral map/layer and public vector download or API.
queries.result: The official Campinas Spatial Metadata service describes a free, no-login public catalog for municipal GIS database layers and says several layers are downloadable as shapefiles. A 2023 municipal Diário Oficial report explicitly identifies the Municipal GIS “Lotes do DIDC” layer. The current metadata site and Zoneamento Online are publicly described, but no actual parcel file/full polygon was retrieved in this environment.
queries.executionMethod: Official Campinas service page and Diário Oficial sources; web page inspection and bounded direct requests to the listed public apps.

queries.query: Campinas municipal GIS cadastral parcel lot layer DIDC public shapefile
queries.scope: Confirm parcel-level service semantics and whether vector geometry is accessible anonymously.
queries.result: The official city describes its free Zoneamento Online service as allowing a user to click a property on the map and inspect information. A separate official service describes the no-login geospatial metadata catalog and shapefile downloads. Direct shell requests to the metadata and zoning hosts timed out after 12 seconds; these environment-side timeouts are not evidence that the city services are down. No public endpoint or geometry contract could therefore be qualified.
queries.executionMethod: Official city service page review and bounded read-only direct GET attempts.

portals.name: Campinas Spatial Metadata catalog

portals.observation: Official city service page says this public, no-login catalog describes layers in municipal GIS databases and that several layers can be downloaded as shapefiles; availability is gradual.

portals.name: Campinas Zoneamento Online
portals.operator: Secretaria Municipal de Planejamento e Desenvolvimento Urbano, Prefeitura de Campinas
portals.observation: Official city service page describes a free public map where users can click an imóvel and inspect information. It is a zoning/property-identification map, not proof of downloadable full parcel vectors.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal GIS database includes an officially referenced DIDC lot layer; the city says several GIS catalog layers are downloadable as shapefiles.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: City-local parcel/lot layer existence and public catalog service are confirmed; actual Lotes layer exposure, downloadable full vectors, WUP-point geometry and citywide extent are not verified.

registryBasis: First-party Campinas municipal documentation names a Municipal GIS “Lotes do DIDC” layer, while city service pages document a public property-click map and a free no-login metadata catalog. This supports a local cadastral/lot registry, but not a verified open geometry endpoint.
technicalBlocker: Direct requests to the public metadata and zoneamento application hosts timed out from the local shell, so the DIDC lot layer listing/endpoint and full polygon response contract could not be inspected.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Lotes do DIDC layer is downloadable in the current metadata catalog, whether its record includes full parcel geometry, and whether the WUP center is covered by that layer.
nextStep: Reach the live metadata catalog through a working public route and inspect the Lotes/DIDC layer metadata/download URL; if available, fetch at most three full polygons near the WUP point and validate IDs, CRS, extent and geometry.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
